brief:
Goal: recover each whole function for a dedicated server that runs the unmodified 12.60 client from lobby through battle royale. These come from the server-scope list (porting/server_scope), proven/strong/likely required. Several functions in a class often share helpers: recover those once and reuse them.

How to work: you have a large budget; use it. Do not stop at the first unnamed callee, unreflected member, virtual slot, timer or config value: open the decompile, read the callee, recover it, write it as a dependency (helper, member or virtual declaration under work/dependencies/) and carry on until the whole function body is written. Each function is finished only when its full body is written, and a function that calls helpers is finished by writing the helpers too. Do not end your run while any listed function lacks a body; if one is hard, work on it longer rather than moving on, and make the most faithful source-level choice the evidence supports, noting residual uncertainty in the evidence file as a CONFIDENCE comment. Record every function as proposed once it has a body. A previous pass on related functions left partial evidence and dependency drafts in work/ and work/dependencies/; reuse them.
